items.title: Jane Ira Bloom interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 3, 1998
items.q: I met astronaut John Young, shook hands with a man who had stepped on the moon.

ctx.x: What launch did you see by the way?

STS 26, which was the first return to flight launch after the Challenger accident. It was an exciting time, yeah. I got to meet a lot of interesting astronauts, I met astronaut John Young, shook hands with a man who had stepped on the moon. He actually spoke and gave a beautiful speech about the future of the arts and music in space, before we did the concert. It was quite wonderful.
You also had a piece performed at Carnegie Hall, isn’t that right?
